limits: All finite-grid outcomes are retained; this is not a continuous offset enclosure or confidence interval.
Gaussian CDF evaluations are float64 approximations, then frozen as exact binary rationals for this finite declared experiment; they are not certified real-valued Gaussian inputs.
Calibration patches, slope bounds, normalized levels, optical model and deterministic output intervals are supplied experimental conditions, not inferred camera evidence.
One common response is tested for each whole candidate profile, not separately for each point.

analytic_gauge.scope: Affine straight Gaussian profile; not a general projective 2-D gauge. Fixed later digital operators preserve identical source fields.
